items.name: form-field-wrapper
items.title: Form Field Wrapper
items.description: Shared field shell for label, control, description, and error. Wrap custom controls with this instead of inventing a second error layout.

items.name: form-field-input
items.title: Form Field Input
items.description: Labeled text input with description and error wiring. Works with react-hook-form register() or plain value/onChange. Do not rebuild Field + Label + Input for a standard text field.

items.name: form-field-textarea
items.title: Form Field Textarea
items.description: Labeled textarea with the shared field shell. Use this for multiline fields; use the textarea primitive only when you need a custom layout.

items.name: form-field-select
items.title: Form Field Select
items.description: Labeled single-value select from an options array. Use this instead of assembling Select, SelectTrigger, SelectContent, and Field by hand for a standard choice.

items.name: form-field-checkbox
items.title: Form Field Checkbox
items.description: Checkbox paired with its label and validation message. Use this for standard boolean fields.
